# VibranceExtension

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Adjust vibrance of a layer.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/vibrance-extension",
  "type": "VibranceExtensionOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
  "data": { "inputs": {} }
}
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/vibrance-extension').par.amount` (an input) and `op('/vibrance-extension').out.extension` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.amount`, `out.extension`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Name | Type | Default |
|------|------|---------|
| `amount` | `NumberField` | `0` |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Outputs

|------|------|
